728-1445-2279-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-2279-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1308-4826-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2584-4694-7839--112.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
2584-4694-7839--112.description:
Deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
When the Treasure(s) enter as creature(s) due to March of the Machines, Pandemonium triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to Smaug.
Repeat from step 2.
2584-4694-7839--112.notes: The anthem effect must boost the power and toughness of artifact creatures you control by 1 or more. While you will get infinite Treasures, because they are creatures, you cannot activate them right away unless you give them haste. If the anthem increases power by 2 or more, you can get additional Pandemonium triggers to deal infinite damage.

997-1263-4556-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3967-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3967-4302-5929.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

101-4377-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and exiling Ephemerate.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1417-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2113-5051-5078-5243.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1486-3459-7223--68.description:
Activate the creature with saddle's saddle ability by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the saddle ability.
Repeat.

1734-2921-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1734-2921-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

1295-2464-3832.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1295-2464-3832.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck size is less than or equal to 2 plus your devotion to blue.
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}. When it enters, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

512-4241-5116.description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Gilded Lotus to become a creature.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Gilded Lotus, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-4241-5116.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Avatar Kuruk.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning The Legend of Kuruk from exile to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1939-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1939-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

81-1978-2750.description:
Cause Kami of Whispered Hopes to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2866-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4927-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

997-3593-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
997-3593-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

1170-1645-5334-5954-6664.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

856-997-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1741-2953-4013.easyPrerequisites: Dawn's Reflection attached a mana-producing land you control.
1741-2953-4013.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {C}.
1741-2953-4013.description:
Activate a land and the land with Dawn's Reflection attached if it isn't the same land by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Dawn's Reflection triggers, adding {2}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the land(s) tapped in step 1.
Repeat.
1741-2953-4013.notes: If Dawn's Reflection is attached to a land that can produce {C} and/or you control a land that can add multiple mana, you may then untap other lands using Cloud of Faeries' ETB ability.

2615-5712.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition's toughness is equal to or less than 10 plus Ezio's power.
An opponent cannot block Ezio.
Tree of Perdition and Ezio do not have summoning sickness.
2615-5712.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Deal combat damage to that opponent using Ezio.
Ezio triggers, causing you to pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} to have that opponent lose the game.

578-3525-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-3525-4758.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

803-4302-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-4302-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2232-3094-3475-4768-4948.notablePrerequisites:
The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
You have at least one non-Saga enchantment card in hand.
2232-3094-3475-4768-4948.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and targeting it, copying The World Spell's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The World Spell's trigger, putting Estrid's Invocation and any non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Choose to have Estrid's Invocation enter the battlefield as a copy of The World Spell, with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Estrid's Invocation triggers once, and Cloudstone Curio and Altar of the Brood each trigger twice.
Resolve both Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Estrid's Invocation and any other non-Saga enchantment from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Estrid's Invocation trigger, putting it and the non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

719-2122-4435-4997.notablePrerequisites:
Mindless Automaton has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
"Merfolk" or "Knight" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2122-4435-4997.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

628-1242-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cinderhaze Wretch, adding {C}{C}.
Cinderhaze Wretch dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

322-717-2546-4270.notablePrerequisites: A basic land card in hand.
322-717-2546-4270.description:
Pay {1} to activate Trade Routes, discarding a basic land and drawing a card.
Bone Miser triggers adding {B} {B} and Surly Badgersaur triggers giving you a treasure.
Sacrifice the treasure for {G} and pay {1} {G} to activate Groundskeeper, returning the basic land to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3.
